zst_how_to_order_guide_v1.title: Step-by-Step Guide: How to Place Your Order
zst_how_to_order_guide_v1.subtitle: Follow these quick steps to order sanitary ware, water pumps, CP fittings, and plumbing materials with ease.
zst_how_to_order_guide_v1.customNote: All orders are verified by our team prior to dispatch. Need assistance? Tap the WhatsApp button to chat with our product specialist.

steps.title: Browse & Add Items to Cart
steps.description: Explore our catalog of luxury CP fittings, wash basins, sanitary ware, water pumps, and plumbing pipes. Select your desired color/variants and click "Add to Cart".
steps.tip: You can review quantities and apply coupon promo codes directly on the Cart review step.

steps.title: Enter Customer Contact Information
steps.description: Provide your full name and active mobile number. Please ensure your WhatsApp number is accurate so we can send your instant order confirmation and tracking alerts.
steps.tip: Existing customers can click "Auto-fill Contact" to instantly load saved profile details.

steps.title: Provide Accurate Delivery Address
steps.description: Select your delivery city (Chiniot, Lahore, Faisalabad, Islamabad, Karachi, etc.) and enter your detailed street address and nearby landmark for courier dispatch.
steps.tip: Delivery charges and estimated transit time are automatically calculated based on your city.

steps.title: Select Your Preferred Payment Method
steps.description: Choose between Cash on Delivery (COD), Meezan Bank Direct Transfer, EasyPaisa, or JazzCash.
steps.tip: For COD on bulk or special orders, a small advance payment may be required to confirm dispatch.

steps.title: Upload Payment Receipt (Online / Advance)
steps.description: If you selected Bank Transfer, EasyPaisa, or JazzCash, transfer the required amount to our official account details displayed on screen and attach a screenshot receipt.
steps.tip: You can take a screenshot on your mobile banking app and upload the image directly.

steps.title: Instant Order Confirmation & Live Tracking
steps.description: Once submitted, you will receive a unique Order ID (e.g. ZST-00001). Our accounts team verifies the payment proof and dispatches your order with real-time tracking.
steps.tip: You can track your parcel live anytime using the Track Order button or through WhatsApp.

steps.title: Step 7: Direct Whatsapp Tracking
steps.description: After Submitting Proof and When Order Placed Click on Live Tracking Whatsapp option to Send Direct Whatsapp Details of Order.
steps.tip: Pro tip or helpful advice for the customer (optional).

zst_products_v1.name: Pioneer Tile Fix / Tile Bond
zst_products_v1.description: The Pioneer Tile Fix is a premium-grade, cement-based porcelain and ceramic tile bond adhesive engineered for superior polymer-modified performance. Designed for both wall and floor applications, this high-strength tiling mortar delivers exceptional bonding capability and waterproof reliability for modern architectural and construction projects.
features: Superior Polymer-Modified Formula: Enhanced with advanced polymers to provide maximum adhesion strength for heavy porcelain, ceramic, and stone tiles.
Dual Wall & Floor Versatility: Engineered to perform reliably across both vertical wall installations and high-traffic horizontal flooring surfaces.
Waterproof Technology: Built-in moisture resistance prevents water seepage, making it ideal for wet areas like bathrooms, kitchens, and exterior spaces.
Heavy-Duty 40KG Packaging: Packaged in a robust bag designed for professional site storage and long-term freshness (store in a dry place).
Professional Grade Reliability: Trusted by contractors and builders for smooth consistency, easy workability, and long-lasting structural integrity.
Exceptional Bond Strength: Secures tiles firmly in place, eliminating hollow spots, shifting, or cracking over time.
Resilient Durability: Withstands temperature fluctuations, heavy loads, and constant moisture exposure without degrading.
Professional Standard: Formulated to meet the rigorous demands of modern construction, ensuring a clean, flawless finish for every project.

zst_products_v1.name: High Quality Service Pump (SP) For Home and Commercial Use
zst_products_v1.description: The SP Pumps High-Performance Water Pump is a heavy-duty, industrial-grade pumping solution engineered for maximum efficiency, robust water displacement, and long-term durability. Designed to handle demanding domestic and agricultural requirements, this orange-bodied centrifugal pump combines high-torque motor performance with rugged cast construction to deliver a consistent, powerful water flow under varying pressure conditions.
features: High-Torque Heavy-Duty Motor: Built with premium winding and insulation to prevent overheating during continuous, high-demand operational cycles.
Rugged Anti-Corrosive Build: Encased in a durable, industrial orange coating that protects the heavy cast body from moisture, rust, and harsh environmental elements.
High-Discharge Efficiency: Engineered with an optimized impeller and volute design to maximize water output speed and volume with minimal energy loss.
Precision Inlet & Outlet Framing: Features reinforced flanged connections designed to secure tight, leak-proof pipe installations for both 3" and standard configurations.
Low-Maintenance Operation: Designed with self-lubricating mechanical seals and robust internal components that reduce wear and tear over extended periods of continuous use.

zst_products_v1.name: DURA MAX P Trap for Bathroom
zst_products_v1.description: The DURAMAX U-PVC P-Trap is a heavy-duty, premium-grade plumbing component engineered for reliable drainage and superior wastewater management. Manufactured with high-impact U-PVC material, this P-trap is built to prevent sewer gases from entering living or commercial spaces while ensuring smooth, clog-resistant flow.
features: Suitable for residential and commercial use

zst_products_v1.name: Paragon Sink Mixer
zst_products_v1.description: Paragon Sink Mixer is a stylish and durable kitchen fitting designed for smooth and convenient water flow control. Its practical design makes it ideal for kitchen sinks, while its reliable construction provides dependable performance for everyday washing and cleaning tasks.
features: Suitable for residential and commercial use

zst_products_v1.name: The Premium Gold Multi-Jet Spa Complete Shower System
zst_products_v1.description: The Premium Gold Multi-Jet Spa Shower System is a luxurious, all-in-one exposed shower fixture designed to transform any modern bathroom into a high-end spa. Featuring a brilliant, tarnish-resistant golden finish, this comprehensive setup integrates an overhead rainfall experience with targeted body massage jets, offering unparalleled functionality and a striking, elegant aesthetic.
features: Ultra-Wide Rainfall Showerhead: A large, square overhead nozzle engineered to deliver a consistent, full-body, rain-like water flow.
Integrated Body Massage Jets: Multiple adjustable wall-mounted nozzles designed for targeted hydrotherapy and a customized spa experience.
Versatile Handheld Wand & Bidet Spray: Includes a flexible hand shower for targeted rinsing and a lower health faucet/bidet attachment for maximum utility.
Tarnish-Resistant Gold Finish: Electroplated surface built to withstand high humidity, resisting water spots, peeling, and daily wear.
Precision Mixer Console: Ergonomic, easy-turn dial controls for seamless switching between water outlets and exact temperature management.
Exposed Wall-Mount Architecture: Streamlined installation that mounts directly to your marble or tile surface without requiring invasive internal wall plumbing.

zst_products_v1.name: The Stylo Premium Dark Charcoal Dual Flush Tank
zst_products_v1.description: The Stylo Premium Dark Charcoal Dual Flush Tank features a sleek, modern silhouette engineered for contemporary bathroom interiors. Built from high-impact, corrosion-proof plastic, it combines an ultra-slim wall-mounted profile with smooth dual-flush efficiency and clear side-panel icon controls.
features: High-Impact Plastic Build: Molded from heavy-duty, crack-resistant polymer for long-term durability and zero corrosion risk.
Dark Charcoal Finish: Modern matte-grey surface that conceals fingerprints, water marks, and daily wear.
Water-Saving Dual Flush: Efficient internal discharge mechanism allowing full and reduced flush options to conserve water.
Intuitive Side Controls: Visual icon panel integrated directly into the front casing for straightforward operation.
Slimline Wall Mount: Compact depth footprint designed to fit neatly against bathroom walls without taking up space.

zst_products_v1.name: Regal Premium Oval Ceramic Wash Basin
zst_products_v1.description: The Regal Premium Oval Ceramic Countertop Washbasin combines a sleek, curved silhouette with a high-gloss vitrified finish. Engineered for modern tabletop mounting, this vanity basin features a deep bowl structure with an integrated faucet shelf, making it a functional, luxury centerpiece for residential and commercial bathrooms.
features: Vitrified Ceramic Construction: Kiln-fired at high temperatures for enhanced durability, impact resistance, and long-term surface strength.
Integrated Faucet Shelf: Designed with a pre-drilled tap hole platform built into the inner rim for seamless mixer installation.
High-Gloss Glaze: Smooth, non-porous finish repels water marks, soap scum, and everyday staining.
Surface-Mounted Vessel Design: Sits directly atop marble, quartz, tile, or wood counter surfaces for a elevated aesthetic.
Ergonomic Oval Bowl: Deep internal contour offers generous water volume while minimizing splashback onto vanity surfaces.

zst_products_v1.name: Premium Creamy Off White Basin Bowl
zst_products_v1.description: The Creamy Off-White Ceramic Countertop Washbasin combines timeless oval geometry with a smooth vitrified glaze. Designed for seamless drop-in or countertop mounting, its warm cream finish and deep basin offer an elegant, spa-like aesthetic that integrates effortlessly with marble, stone, and luxury bathroom interiors.
features: Vitrified Ceramic Construction: High-temperature fired for a dense, scratch-resistant surface.
Warm Cream Finish: High-gloss off-white glaze that offers a soft alternative to harsh white porcelain.
Deep Ergonomic Basin: Smooth oval contour designed to maximize water volume while preventing splashing.
Integrated Overflow & Tap Hole: Pre-drilled for quick faucet mounting with built-in overflow protection.
Universal Countertop Fit: Compact oval layout compatible with marble, wood, or quartz vanity tops.
Effortless Cleaning: Non-porous glazed surface repels water spots, soap scum, and bacterial build-up.
Long-Lasting Durability: Resists yellowing, chipping, and abrasive wear under daily commercial or residential use.
Versatile Interior Match: Warm neutral tone pairs seamlessly with gold, matte black, or chrome fixtures.
Hassle-Free Installation: Standard outlet dimensions ensure direct compatibility with standard plumbing fittings.

zst_products_v1.name: Best Aisa Soft Green Colour Premium Basin
zst_products_v1.description: The Best Asia Premium Soft-Green Pedestal Washbasin blends modern curved geometry with high-grade ceramic craftsmanship. features: High-Gloss Vitrified Finish: Fired under extreme heat to create a dense, non-porous ceramic surface that resists chipping, scratching, and color fading over time.

Universal Fitting Standard: Features standard waste outlet sizing and pre-drilled tap hole compatibility for hassle-free installation with standard plumbing fixtures.

zst_products_v1.name: Master Water Storage Tanks For Home and Commercial
zst_products_v1.description: The Master Plus 2-Ply Water Tank is engineered for high-durability, hygienic, and long-lasting water storage across residential, commercial, and industrial settings.
